message:
test: cover DTLS 1.3 ACK reads across timeout expiry

Expire the client's retransmission timer from a BIO read callback as
the server's ACK arrives. Keep the timer out of the way until that
callback so the test does not depend on elapsed time or sleeps, and
check that the callback ran.

Without the ACK assembly fix, the second record read retransmits the
client's Finished and overwrites the ACK prefix in init_buf, causing
SSL_R_LENGTH_TOO_LONG. With the fix, the handshake completes. The test
also passes alongside the pending ACK-coverage change in #32854.
